title: Energy Efficiency & Demand Response Internship - Summer 2027
description:
About Us

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Wabash Valley Power is a not-for-profit electric cooperative and wholesale provider of reliable, affordable electricity to our 21 electric distribution member cooperatives. These cooperatives in turn serve more than 280,000 homes, businesses, and farms in Indiana, Illinois, and Missouri.

As a not-for-profit co-op, we do things a bit differently—and that’s the point. Because we aren’t influenced by shareholders, we make our decisions with our members in mind. That means we value things like teamwork, and putting families first. It also means a business model that’s designed for stability and growth. It’s a Deliberately Different approach to the energy industry, and that’s great news for the people who count on us.

Objective: WVPA is seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Energy Efficiency & Demand Response Intern to join our Strategic Electrification and Member Relations team for Summer 2027.
This internship provides hands on experience in utility energy programs, data analysis, member engagement, and emerging distributed energy resource technologies. The intern will work alongside industry professionals supporting programs that improve energy efficiency, reduce peak demand, strengthen grid reliability, and enhance the value provided to member cooperatives and their members.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
• Analyzing participation, savings, energy consumption, and program performance data.
• Supporting energy efficiency and rebate programs, including tracking participation and evaluating program results.
• Supporting demand response programs, including PowerShift® and related initiatives.
• Assisting with participant enrollment tracking, program reporting, and peak demand reduction analysis.
• Collecting, cleaning, and analyzing energy, program, and customer data.
• Creating dashboards, charts, presentations, and reports to communicate program results.
• Supporting the development of key performance indicators and strategic reporting.
• Researching emerging energy efficiency technologies, distributed energy resources, battery storage, load flexibility, electrification, and industry best practices.
• Assisting with educational, marketing, and member outreach materials.
• Participating in meetings with member cooperative representatives.
• Helping coordinate trainings, educational events, and working group activities.
• Assisting with presentations, surveys, communications, and other member engagement initiatives.
• Supporting special projects involving energy efficiency, demand response, distributed energy resources, and strategic electrification.
• Gaining exposure to utility operations, energy markets, demand side management, and distributed energy resources while working with teams across engineering, operations, member relations, and strategic electrification.

Education/Experience Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Economics, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI is a plus.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively in a team environment.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Interest in energy efficiency, demand response, renewable energy, battery storage, electrification, distributed energy resources, or utility operations.

Wabash Valley Power Alliance reserves the right to request official or unofficial transcripts as part of the selection process to verify educational qualifications, coursework, academic standing, and/or eligibility for the internship.
This is a paid summer internship opportunity located in Indianapolis, Indiana. Please note that housing or a housing stipend is not provided.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About Us

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Wabash Valley Power is a not-for-profit electric cooperative and wholesale provider of reliable, affordable electricity to our 21 electric distribution member cooperatives. These cooperatives in turn serve more than 280,000 homes, businesses, and farms in Indiana and Illinois. 

As a not-for-profit co-op, we do things a bit differently—and that’s the point. Because we aren’t influenced by shareholders, we make our decisions with our members in mind. That means we value things like teamwork, and putting families first. It also means a business model that’s designed for stability and growth. It’s a Deliberately Different approach to the energy industry, and that’s great news for the people who count on us.
What You'll Get

We believe what benefits our employees benefits our company. That’s why we put employees first—your health, your family, and your development. These aren’t just slogans: We offer continuing education, flex time, health benefits, a 401(k) match and pension plan, and much more. Here are just a few of the things that make our company culture unique:
•   No Sweat   - We offer a wellness program that includes a payroll credit for medical insurance, an on-site fitness center for your convenience and extra vacation days for participating. We’ll even throw in a fitness device reimbursement to keep you on track!

•   Flex Time   - Our flexible schedule means you can work in your appointments or family events and maintain a comfortable work-life balance.

•   Stay in School  -  We value employees who have a desire to learn, so we provide funds for continuing education. We also offer in-house training and ongoing development through our internal GROW program.

•   Keep it Casual   - When you work for us, you work in comfort.  Blue jeans are the norm in our office, and we make them look good!

•   Work Hard, Play Hard   - We reward our employees with generous vacation time, to the tune of up to five weeks off a year. Even our new employees receive credit for prior work experience.

This position will design, implement, and support artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) systems as the subject matter expert for Wabash Valley Power Alliance. This position will work with all business units, member cooperatives, and business partners to automate and optimize workflows and processes while limiting business risks. Success requires a desire to work with a broad range of technologies, systems, and databases to benefit Wabash Valley Power and our Member Cooperatives.  This position will also identify and develop AI/ML education for Wabash Valley Power and member cooperative staff. 
This role is hybrid in nature, with a combination of on-site workdays and remote workdays. 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures

- Present artificial intelligence and data finding to technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Design, implement, administer, monitor, and maintain artificial intelligence/machine learning systems

- Design, analyze, and maintain system algorithms including data models, natural language models, and machine learning models

- Train and evaluate artificial intelligence system to ensure systems remain accurate with limited hallucinations

- Perform complex analysis on large data sets and communicate meaningful intelligence to Technical Service Leadership

- Research, prototype, and recommend new technology platforms or systems to improve business workflows and reduce risks

- Maintain a constant level of expertise in all artificial intelligence technologies including but not limited to generative AI, machine learning, natural language processing, and deep learning

- Develop and maintain computer code need for artificial intelligence system and business automation systems

- Develop and implement AI models for tasks such as:
- Predictive maintenance: Analyze sensor data to predict equipment failures and optimize maintenance scheduling

- Load forecasting: Improve the accuracy of electricity demand forecasts to ensure reliable and cost-effective power generation

- Develop and present reports on systems and business workflows

- Develop and foster relationships with universities AI/ML programs

- Education end-users on AI/ML tools and how they can be used within the organization and member cooperatives

- Perform additional activities needed to demonstrate regulatory compliance with NERC CIP security standards.

- Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative science, engineering, or other STEM field

- Three to five years prior artificial intelligence/machine learning or data analysis experience

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers

- Excellent technology proficiency with a strong commitment to continuous learning

- Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service

- Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices

Preferred Experience: 

- Any system, network, or cybersecurity related experience or certifications are a plus

- Experience working with data rich problems in research or professional projects is a plus

- Graduate degree in data science, computational science, or artificial intelligence is a plus

- Experience with data analysis tools such as R and Python

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
